components.css: .ds-spine{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;background:#19191a;color:#f3f0ee;font:450 .875rem/1.375rem var(--font-urbanist), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif}.ds-spine li{position:relative;padding:0 0 1rem 2rem}.ds-spine li::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:10.5px;top:0;bottom:0;width:1px;background:#605e5e}.ds-spine li:first-child::before{top:1.05rem}.ds-spine li:last-child::before{bottom:calc(100% - 1.05rem)}.ds-spine b{display:block;font-weight:650}.ds-spine small{display:block;font-size:.75rem;line-height:1rem;color:#a39b98}.ds-spine code{font-family:var(--font-jetbrains), ui-monospace, monospace}.ds-node{position:absolute;left:6px;top:.74rem;width:10px;height:10px;box-sizing:border-box;border-radius:999px;background:#19191a;border:1.5px solid #938a87;z-index:1}.ds-node[data-tone=solid]{background:#938a87}.ds-node[data-tone=ok]{border-color:#88c098}.ds-node[data-tone=warn]{border-color:#e0b066}.ds-node[data-live=true]::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:-4px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid #e0b066;animation:ds-pulse 1.8s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) infinite}@keyframes ds-pulse{from{transform:scale(.6);opacity:.7}to{transform:scale(1.5);opacity:0}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-node::after{animation:none}}

narrative.overview:
Gitarchy is a dark, warm-graphite developer workspace where repository hosting and Spark analytics share one visual grammar. Everything is a ledger: rows ruled by 1px lines, history threaded down a single vertical rail, code sunk into near-black wells. The accent is a desaturated warm stone, used sparingly enough that it reads as "you are here" rather than decoration.

Density is high and calm. Product UI runs on a 14px body with a tight 1.2 scale; only the landing page is allowed a large display headline. Depth comes from tonal layering (shell darker than canvas, wells darker still, menus lighter), not from cards or shadows. The one recurring signature is the commit spine: the same rail-and-ring-node form carries commit history, activity feeds, the sidebar nav, the landing feature list and the Spark job lifecycle.
keyCharacteristics: Dark warm-graphite canvas with tonal layers, never pure black UI chrome.
1px rules instead of cards; corners never exceed 4px.
Stone accent reserved for selection, the active rail node and spine nodes.
State colours (sage, amber, brick, slate) appear only where they carry meaning, always with a glyph or label.
Urbanist for all UI; JetBrains Mono only for code, hashes, paths, Spark operators and table numerals.
The commit spine is the signature form across hosting and analytics.

rules.name: The Stone Is A Marker Rule
rules.body: Stone marks position and selection: the active node, the selected radio card, the highlighted code line. It is not a fill for buttons, banners or headings.

rules.name: The Meaning-Only State Rule
rules.body: Sage, amber, brick and slate appear only when the thing is in that state, and always paired with a glyph or text label; colour alone never carries status.

rules.name: The Small-Text Floor Rule
rules.body: Small text on surface or raised uses fg-3 or lighter. Stone is not small text on surface; fg-4 is disabled-only.

rules.name: The Mono Means Machine Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is for code, hashes, paths, branch names, Spark operators and numerals. Never for headings, labels or prose.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels, table headers, group labels and day separators are sentence case at normal or near-normal tracking. No uppercase tracked labels.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Tables and data numerals always use tabular figures.

rules.name: The Floating-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: Only things in the top layer cast shadows. Panels, tables and sections never do; they separate with 1px rules and tone.

dos: Do separate regions with 1px rules (line `#363636`, line-soft `#262627`) and tonal steps, not cards.
Do keep every corner at 4px or less; circles are only for nodes, dots, avatars and progress tracks.
Do thread any history, feed or multi-step process down the commit spine with toned ring nodes.
Do pair every state colour with a glyph or a text label.
Do set code, hashes, paths and Spark operators in JetBrains Mono, and everything else in Urbanist.
Do use one inverted bone primary button per view; the rest are default, ghost or danger.
Do transition state changes over 150ms on `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` and honour reduced motion.
Do label illustrative content with a "Sample data" chip.
donts: Don't use stone as a button fill, banner, or small text on surface (4.26:1).
Don't use fg-4 (`#7a7574`) for anything but disabled text and placeholders.
Don't add shadows to panels, tables or sections; shadows are for menus, dialogs, toasts and tooltips only.
Don't build hero-metric card grids or a separate admin-dashboard look for analytics; analytics uses the same tables, spine and charts as hosting.
Don't use uppercase tracked labels or kicker lines above headings.
Don't use the state colours for chart polarity; use the cool/warm pair.
